card.fact_statement: The Spanish government approved €10.6 billion in fiscal aid for people affected by the 2024 Spanish floods.
card.source_span: approved a decree to provide €10.6 billion (amounting to €60,000 per household) in fiscal aid to people affected by the floods.

target_qa_variants.question: Quel montant d'aide fiscale le gouvernement espagnol a-t-il approuvé pour les personnes touchées par les inondations espagnoles de 2024 ?
target_qa_variants.source_span: approved a decree to provide €10.6 billion (amounting to €60,000 per household) in fiscal aid to people affected by the floods.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'billion' to 'milliards' and adapted the currency format to standard French usage.
